findings.title: Enhancing Post Earnings Announcement Drift Measurement with Large Language Models
findings.key_metric: FinBERT accuracy 57.6-58.3% on earnings call transcripts; PEAD.txt maintains alpha vs. attenuated numeric PEAD

findings.title: FinBERT2: A Specialized Bidirectional Encoder for Finance
findings.key_metric: +0.4-3.3% accuracy vs. FinBERT1; +9.7-12.3% vs. GPT-4/Claude on classification

findings.title: Conditional vol-scaling + 52-week-high filter (literature synthesis)
findings.source: Daniel & Moskowitz RFS 2016 + Bongaerts et al. 2020 (updated survey)
findings.key_metric: Conditional gating reduces crash risk further; 52w-high filter removes crash-prone overextended winners

findings.title: AlphaCrafter: Full-Stack Multi-Agent Framework for Cross-Sectional Quantitative Trading
findings.key_metric: Sharpe 0.72 (S&P 500), live-trading robust (competitors degrade 2-3x in live)

findings.title: Toward Expert Investment Teams: Fine-Grained Multi-Agent LLM System
findings.key_metric: Sharpe +0.08 to +0.26 from structured vs. raw agent inputs

findings.title: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
findings.key_metric: Sharpe 5.60 on 3-month cherry-picked backtest (suspect); 59.9k GitHub stars
findings.note: Sharpe 5.60 not credible for OOS deployment. Monitor for updates.

findings.title: Cointegration-based pairs trading on similar ETFs (Springer 2025)
findings.source: Springer Journal of Asset Management Vol. 26 Issue 5
findings.key_metric: Sharpe 0.28 on 30 ETF pairs 2000-2024; cointegration windows short-lived (<6 months)
findings.note: Confirms H114/H200 finding: ETF-level pairs have weak edge. No LLM-guided pair selection published yet.

findings.title: VectorBT — vectorized backtesting 100x faster than event-driven
findings.note: Current framework (custom engine) sufficient for monthly-frequency strategies. VectorBT migration worthwhile if daily/intraday strategies are added.

not_staged_reasons.ETF pairs Springer: Sharpe 0.28 confirms existing conclusion; ETF pairs family exhausted
